title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 45
paragraphs: Thus the fleet fared. Meanwhile Mardonius and the land-army, while encamped in Macedonia, were attacked in the night by the Brygian Thracians, and many of them were killed by the Brygi, and Mardonius himself was wounded. However, not even these escaped being enslaved by the Persians, for Mardonius did not depart from that region until he had made them subject. After subduing them, he proceeded to lead his army back, since he had suffered heavy losses with his land-army in fighting against the Brygi and with his fleet in going round Athos. So this expedition returned to Asia having gained no honor by its contests.
